guidance.claim: We are maintaining our PBDIT margin guidance at 18-20%.

guidance.claim: We expect full year volume growth to be in the 8-10% band.
guidance.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: The weighted average price increase would possibly be in the 8-9% range.

guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: Industrial will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative.
